Then P_h u = I_h u on partial Omega and A'(u;P_h u - u, phi) = A'(u;I_h G - G, phi) ,~ forall phi in V_h cap H_0^1(Omega). Put w=u-G. Since w=0 on partial Omega and w is smooth, we have ||w- hatP_h(w)||_W^1,infty leq C h^k ||w||_W^k+1,infty, \ for w in W^k+1,infty(Omega), w=0 on partial Omega. Therefore ||u-P_h u||_W^1,infty & = ||w+ G - hatP_h w-I_h G ||_W^1,infty \\ & leq ||w- hatP_h w||_W^1,infty +||G-I_h G||_W^1,infty. It thus follows from the approximation properties of I_h that ||u-P_h u||_W^1,infty leq C h^k ||u||_W^k+1,infty equiv C_1 h^k, \ for u in W^k+1,infty(Omega). By an inverse estimate, , and the approximation properties of I_h, we have ||u-P_h u||_W^2,infty(T_h) &leq ||u-I_h u ||_W^2,infty(T_h) + ||I_h u -P_h u||_W^2,infty(T_h) \\ & leq C h^k-1 ||u||_W^k+1,infty + C h^-1 big( ||I_h u - u||_W^1,infty + || u-P_h u||_W^1,infty big), that is ||u-P_h u||_W^2,infty(T_h) &leq C h^k-1 ||u||_W^k+1,infty . Following , we will obtain pointwise estimates via the use of discrete Green's functions. We have for h sufficiently small \|g^z_h,i\|_W^1,1 leq C |ln h|, and \|G^z_h\|_L^2 leq C, where the constant C is independent of z. For $v_h$ and $w_h$  in $B_h$,

\begin{align*}
\begin{split}
A'(u;\Phi( v_h)- \Phi( w_h),\phi) 
&= A'(u;\Phi( v_h)-  v_h,\phi)+A'(u; v_h- w_h,\phi) \\
& \qquad \qquad \qquad \qquad \qquad  + A'(u;w_h - \Phi( w_h),\phi)\\
&= A_{}( w_h,\phi)  -A_{}( v_h,\phi) + A'(u; v_h- w_h,\phi) \\
&=  A_{}( w_h,\phi)  -A_{}( v_h,\phi) + A'(u; v_h -u,\phi) + A'(u; u - w_h,\phi).
\end{split}
\end{align*}
Since $A(u,\phi)=0$, by definition of the residual \eqref{rdef0}, we have
$$
A'(u;\Phi( v_h)- \Phi( w_h),\phi) = R(u;w_h-u,\phi) - R(u;v_h-u,\phi).
$$
Using algebraic manipulations of the type identified in Lemma \ref{algebraic} and \eqref{R1-simple}, we obtain

\begin{multline} \label{expr-con}

+ \frac{1}{2} \sum_{K \in \mathcal{T}_h}  \int_K [(\operatorname{cof} D^2 (v_h - u) ) D (w_h -  v_h)  ]  \cdot D \phi \,d x \\

+ \[(\operatorname{cof} D^2 (v_h-u)) \] \{\!\{ D (w_h-v_h) \}\!\} \bigg) \phi \,d s \\
+ \frac{1}{2} \sum_{e \in \mathcal{E}_h^i } \int_e \bigg( \[ \{\!\{\operatorname{cof} D^2 (w_h-v_h) \}\!\} D (w_h-u) \] 
+ \[ \{\!\{\operatorname{cof} D^2 (v_h-u) \}\!\} D (w_h-v_h) \] \bigg) \phi\,d s.
\end{multline} 
Arguing as in the proof of Lemma \ref{invariant} and using \eqref{w11-phi}, we obtain
\begin{multline*}
|A'(u;\Phi( v_h)- \Phi( w_h),\phi) | \leq 
 C \Big(   || w_h- v_h||_{W^{2,\infty}(\mathcal{T}_h) } ||w_h-u||_{W^{1,\infty}} \\

A uniform grid is obtained by dividing the domain into smaller equal size squares, then dividing each square into two triangles by taking the diagonal with positive slope.
